title: The Locked Room
selection_exposition: After Fei wins the Battling tournament but before the escape from Kislev, a sealed room tied to Anne draws Rico into Nortune's Imperial residence.<New>The questions waiting there lead directly to Kaiser Sigmund.<Close>
blocks:
CHAPTER 3
THE LOCKED ROOM<New>Nortune Central District.<Close>

[Rico enters a sealed chamber in
the Imperial residence. The lock
opens at the touch of his hand.]<Close>

SYSTEM
FAMILY SEAL ACCEPTED.
ANNE BANDERAS HOUSEHOLD RECORD
ACCESS RESTORED.<Close>

<Citan>
This security system is quite old,
but its response was unmistakable.<New>It recognized you, Rico.<Close>

<Fei>
Then the Kaiser has to know who you
are.<Close>

[Sigmund enters with the palace
guard. His eyes move from Rico to
the open family seal.]<Close>

Sigmund
This chamber is restricted. Remove
the intruders.<Close>

<Rico>
The door opened for me.<New>You know why.<Close>

Sigmund
The mechanism is decades old. Its
recognition circuit has failed.<Close>

<Rico>
Look at me and say that.<Close>

Sigmund
Return him to Committee custody.
The others are to leave Nortune.<Close>

<Fei>
Kaiser, the scanner record can be
checked. You don't have to do this.<Close>

[The guards close around Rico. He
looks once at the room, waiting for
Sigmund to stop them.]<Close>

<Rico>
Mother spent her life giving you a
reason.<New>You did not even need to believe
her. You only had to look.<Close>

[Sigmund says nothing. The family
door closes, and Rico is returned
to the people who condemned him.]<Close>

<Rico>
Maybe he did not know before.<New>He knows now.<Close>
